promotion_text.target: analysis/pp49_51/canon_256.bin (coordinator action only; this lane moved/renamed/copied no file in data/ or analysis/)
promotion_text.text: payload_resolved.bin (analysis/round19/C1/payload_resolved.bin == analysis/round18/L5-payload/payload_resolved.bin) is promoted to the canonical 256-byte pp49-51 payload per the owner's Option A decision of 2026-10-29. It differs from the former canon_256.bin at exactly idx 45 (81->107), 50 (21->47), 246 (224->198), vouched for by the R19-C1 pixel instrument and the R28-L2 blind instrument. Before promotion every reader of canon_256.bin that could be re-run was re-fed the corrected bytes: R33-B1 (B-04 payload-derived seeds, R16 zeroFP E-01 and E-02; R17 not re-runnable) and R34-P1 (R16-KDF 7 secrets, R30-B1 and R30-B2 canon legs, recon h1_index, campaign18 payload_skip / payload_ciphertext / numeric2_skip, pp49_51 hash_hunt): no result changed. The legs that need gitignored T2.bin/folly.bin/2.jpg could not be re-run and remain listed in not_covered. The old file is retained as canon_256_superseded.bin. canon_256.hex and canon_256_decpref.bin are separate files: the hex mirrors the old bytes and is read by numeric2_skip and hash_hunt; the decpref carries the same three uncorrected bytes (R33-B1 and R34-P1 used a patched copy and wrote nothing). The capsule MANIFEST.json item payload.canon_256 must be updated to sha256 3b9b07d9a26e6d55c432d94d2661fdff3c2b348daed06821f2bdb23184a4b290 (regenerated copy: round34/P1-payload-promotion/manifest_regen/MANIFEST.regen.json). round17 pads_manifest.json and results*.json record the old pad sha and are historical; leave them.
